name: Releases
tagline: A changelog you can draft, publish and edit
summary: Read a repository's releases as a changelog timeline, open one release with its notes and downloads, and, with push access, draft, publish, edit or delete releases.

flow.label: Releases list route
flow.note: Prefetches the first page of releases, the repo overview and the viewer's permission.

flow.label: getRepoReleases
flow.note: Lists 10 releases per page with the user's token and marks the one GitHub calls latest.

flow.label: ReleaseTimelineItem
flow.note: Shows date, name and status; notes and assets fold open, and only the newest starts open.

flow.label: Release form
flow.note: Loads the default branch, permission and the release being edited, then mounts the form.

flow.label: Save rules
flow.note: Validates the tag and builds the create or update payload for publish or save as draft.

flow.label: createRepoRelease
flow.note: Creates or updates the release on GitHub and returns it for the detail cache.

features.name: Release timeline
features.summary: Releases as a dated changelog with draft, prerelease and latest badges. Long notes are clamped with a link to the full release.

features.name: Release page
features.summary: One release looked up by tag, with its notes rendered as Markdown and its assets shown open.

features.name: Assets and source archives
features.summary: Uploaded assets with size and download count, plus GitHub's source archives. Drafts hide the archives because the tag may not exist yet.

features.name: Draft, publish and edit
features.summary: One form saves as draft or publishes. Saving a published release never demotes it to draft, and a prerelease is never marked latest.

features.name: Generate release notes
features.summary: Asks GitHub to draft notes for the tag range and applies them only if you have not typed or changed the range in the meantime.

features.name: Tag and branch pickers
features.summary: Pick an existing tag or type a new one to be created from a chosen branch on publish. Names are checked against git's ref rules.

features.name: Delete release
features.summary: A confirm-and-delete control on cards and in the form, shown only to viewers with push access.

issues.note: Looks answered: releases pages shipped in #192 on Nov 8.
